julia_cs: Heads-up: Harborline onboarding shows bursty drops during end-of-day peak, flagged as a renewal risk if we don't reduce latency/cost before next billing. Looking for a quick, low-risk optimization plan.
nate_infra: What do metrics say? p95, error rate?
julia_cs: p95 ~420ms on gen endpoint, p99 spikes to ~780ms during 5-6pm window. Token cost is ~2.1x expected for their avg payload length (~120 tokens).
leo_se: OK. For short, transactional prompts we can try a mixed-strategy: 1) route a slice to rw-compact-7b (smaller model with tuned prompts), 2) enable int4 quant profile on compatible instances, 3) apply customer-keyed KV prefix caching for repeated user prompts.
tara_research: Ran 300-sample mini-eval on their sanitized prompt bank: int4 q_profile (q4x) had a small ROUGE drop ~1.1 but intent/slot F1 remained stable at 97.2. Compact model matched critical fields for 285/300.
julia_cs: Sounds promising. What's your recommended canary plan?
leo_se: Suggest staged rollout: 15% -> 30% -> 60% over 72h, only during 16:30-18:30 window. Auto-rollback triggers: intent_f1_drop > 1.5%, error_rate_increase > 0.5%, p95_latency_increase_ms > 150.
nate_infra: Can add a real-time route rule with weight TTL and a cache toggle. I'll need the YAML snippet for the customer team.
julia_cs: Paste below. Replace <customer-id> and model names as needed.
```
- name: harborline-peak-mix
  match: customer == "harborline" and region == "us-east-1"
  window: "16:30-18:30"
  stages:
    - pct: 15
      model: "rw-compact-7b-v1"
    - pct: 85
      model: "rw-base-13b-v1"
  probes:
    - metric: intent_f1
      threshold_drop_pct: 1.5
    - metric: error_rate
      threshold_abs: 0.5
    - metric: p95_latency_ms
      threshold_increase_ms: 150
  enable_prefix_cache: true
  cache_ttl_h: 24
```
leo_se: Nice. Also recommend a fallback route to rw-base-13b-int8 as intermediate if compact shows any content-loss signals.
tara_research: I'll wire an eval hook to run the post-canary 200-sample QA every 6h and post a summary here. I'll include hallucination flags and token-diff histograms.
julia_cs: Operational checklist for CS -> infra handoff:
- Request: enable q4x profile for rw-base-13b-v1 and deploy rw-compact-7b-v1 as canary target
- Routing: add harborline-peak-mix rule in us-east-1
- Cache: enable customer-scoped KV prefix caching, TTL 24h
- Monitoring: intent_f1, error_rate, p95_latency, cost_perk_token as primary KPIs
- Rollback: immediate auto-fallback on thresholds + manual postmortem within 2h

nate_infra: I'll schedule deployment tonight at 16:20 PT and ensure the fallback route is pre-configured. deploy_bot: rollout scheduled (id: roll-6182022022-01) at 16:20 PT.
deploy_bot: [bot] Canary started for roll-6182022022-01. Observability: latency, errors, intent_f1, cost.
julia_cs: I'll reach out to Harborline's PM to set expectation and ask them to enable the 3-question in-app feedback prompt for a subset of users. Low-friction: thumbs up/down + one optional comment.
leo_se: Quick cost estimate: int4 + 15% compact routing approx -22% token spend; if we push to 60% compact over time we could see -38%. Put into renewal notes.
julia_cs: Adding to renewal pack. Tara, please post first eval summary to this thread within 12h. Nate, update me when KV wired.
tara_research: Will do 1:00 UTC summary planned.
nate_infra: KV hooks wired and tested, webhook for QA reports pointing to /hooks/harborline-evals.
julia_cs: Great. After 48h we'll reconvene and decide whether to formalize into a renewal discount + performance SLA. Thanks team. :rocket:
